tools.name: search_trainers
tools.description: Find personal trainers listed on UK Fitness Pro, a directory of personal trainers across the United Kingdom. Give a UK town, city, area or postcode as `location` (or `online: true` for trainers who coach remotely). Returns trainers within about 12 miles (20km), nearest first, with a link to each pro

tools.name: get_trainer_profile
tools.description: Get the public profile of one personal trainer on UK Fitness Pro by username (the `username` from search_trainers, or the last part of a profile URL such as ukfitness.pro/jane.smith). tools.name: find_location
tools.description: Resolve a UK place name or postcode to coordinates and the matching search page on UK Fitness Pro. Returns up to 5 candidates, best first, with the county or region where known. Use it when a place name is ambiguous (there are many Newports), then pass the chosen latitude/longitude to search_trainer

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the fitness, training and nutrition articles published on UK Fitness Pro, some written by trainers listed on the site. Returns titles, short summaries and links. With no query, returns the latest articles.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trainer_profile · Private data: search_trainers, get_trainer_profile · Public sink: get_trainer_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_trainer_profile · Private data: search_trainers, get_trainer_profile · Public sink: get_trainer_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
